title: paeonia peregrina var. banatica
intro: Paeonia peregrina var. banatica, commonly known as the Balkan peony, is a plant species belonging to the Paeoniaceae family. It is a perennial herb that has been traditionally used in medicine, particularly in the Balkan region, for its potential health benefits. The health benefits of Balkan peony are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestive issues, and exhibit antioxidant properties, making it a potential treatment for various health conditions. The plant's bioactive constituents include paeoniflorin, paeonol, and benzylisoferoylquinic acid, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic effects.
